text.card: A red giant 2,986 parsecs away, 15 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 1.74 solar masses and 15.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,788 K at its surface.
